_meta.purpose: Double-check whether public data was MISSED that could re-power the FAILED leave-HLA-out H4 gate without a CRO experiment. Target = NEW hard-essential antigen-processing KO (B2M/TAP1/TAP2/TAPBP/tapasin, plus NLRC5/PSMB8-10/CIITA) immunopeptidome deposits across a DISTINCT HLA background, with WT control + processed peptide files.
_meta.gate_requirement_recap: PASS needs >=3 DISJOINT-ALLELE hard-essential-KO<->WT immunopeptidome backgrounds. Public set to date = HAP1 only (the sole hard-essential collapse). A375/THP-1/HeLa all share HLA-A*02 and only carry weak/inverted trimmer-editor KOs (ERAP1/TAPBPR) or a non-collapsing B2M-KO (A375). So the corpus is under-powered on the discriminative axis AND collapses onto A*02.
_meta.search_scope: PRIDE v2 REST (312-project immunopeptidome/ligandome/APM pool, 27 keyword queries), ProteomeXchange/proteomecentral PROXI, MassIVE https + GNPS datasette, IEDB-adjacent web search, targeted WebSearch/WebFetch on 2024-2026 B2M/TAP/tapasin/NLRC5 KO ligandome literature.
_meta.exclusion_set: 23 HELD + 10 FETCHED accessions from H4_CORPUS_INVENTORY.json + PXD023044; NOT re-counted.
_meta.disk_note: 4.8-5.9 GB free throughout; only 1 small (44 MB) processed matrix pulled to VERIFY availability (PXD063813 report.pr_matrix.tsv).

headline.verdict: CRO-not-shrinkable CONFIRMED. No qualifying public data was missed. One genuinely new B2M-KO deposit (PXD063813) was found, but it (a) shares HLA-A*02 with the already-collapsed public backgrounds (adds NO disjoint allele) and (b) ships only a TRYPTIC whole-proteome DIA matrix as its processed file -- the immunopeptidome would require full raw reprocessing. It cannot re-power the disjoint-allele gate.

gate_criteria_status_after_rescan.disjoint_HLA_alleles_available: still NO -- every public hard-essential KO (HAP1 B2M/TAP/TAPBP, A375 B2M, and NEW C1R/K562 B2M) is on backgrounds already in the corpus or on A*02
gate_criteria_status_after_rescan.hard_essential_KO_backgrounds_with_usabl: still 1 (HAP1). PXD063813 does not add one because its processed file is proteome, not ligandome.

PXD063813.title: The covalent bonding of beta-2-microglobulin with HLA class I influences the antigenic landscape of cells
PXD063813.access: OPEN (PRIDE, no auth; https mirror ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk works)
PXD063813.HLA_background: HLA-A*02 in BOTH lines (C1R-A02, K562-A02). NOT DISJOINT -- A*02 is the exact allele the gate flagged as saturated (shared by A375/THP-1/HeLa).
PXD063813.hard_essential_KO: B2M knockout ('NoB2M' arm) in each line
PXD063813.same_flask_proteome_present: the processed matrix IS a proteome (tryptic) search; a distinct eluate-only proteome is not separately provided

processed_peptide_files.modality_of_processed: TRYPTIC WHOLE-PROTEOME DIA-NN search -- CONFIRMED from report.log.txt: '--cut K*,R* --missed-cleavages 1', avg peptide length 14.3, ~7800 proteins/run, 99% of 8-12mers end in K/R.
processed_peptide_files.immunopeptidome_ligandome_processed_tabl: NOT provided. Only 24 raw .d.zip files. Getting the eluted-ligand repertoire requires a fresh no-enzyme reprocessing of the raw TIMS files (disk-prohibitive here).

gate_verification_attempted.metric: within-deposit unique-precursor detection-count fraction of WT (on the held pr_matrix)
gate_verification_attempted.interpretation: These numbers reflect the PROTEOME (unchanged by B2M-KO, as expected) -- NOT presentation. They are NOT a valid presentation-collapse readout because the matrix is tryptic proteome, not HLA eluate. Cannot be used to resolve the A375 B2M-KO discordance from this file alone.

why_it_does_not_re-power_the_gate: Adds NO disjoint HLA allele (A*02 already saturated in the failing folds).
Its processed file is proteome, not ligandome -- so it does not add a usable hard-essential-KO<->WT PRESENTATION contrast without heavy raw reprocessing.
Even if reprocessed, it would be a 3rd/4th A*02 B2M-KO replicate, deepening the A*02 axis the gate already has, not extending allele coverage.
PXD063813.residual_value_if_processed_later: Could help ADJUDICATE the A375 B2M-KO non-collapse (the primary CRO blocker): C1R and K562 are HLA-null parents with a single defined A*02, so a clean B2M-KO collapse there vs A375's 88% retention would localize the anomaly to A375 (leaky KO / MHC1-TIP sensitivity) rather than to A*02 biology. This is a CHEAP DIAGNOSTIC lead, not a gate re-power.

candidates_examined_and_REJECTED.why: NLRC5-/- but MOUSE fibrosarcoma tumor tissue -- no human HLA background; wrong species for the gate.
RNF185/tapasin ERAD regulation; TMT PROTEOMICS screen (tapasin is a substrate), not an eluted immunopeptidome KO contrast; human+mouse.

Tapasin-DEPENDENCE via HLA-B*44:02/44:05/W147A in 721.220 -- editor-level allele system (same paradigm as held PXD063219/PXD046825), not a hard-essential collapse; no tapasin-null vs WT presentation collapse.
Tapasin-mediated Trp editing on HLA-B44 -- editor effect, not hard-essential KO.
SUMO program restricts immunopeptidome; immunoproteasome effect is indirect/downstream, no hard-essential KO; processed files are MaxQuant peptides.txt (proteome).
HeLa-CIITA is the fixed BACKGROUND; the perturbation is T6BP/TAX1BP1 silencing (autophagy receptor), class-II, not a CIITA/hard-essential KO.
NOTCH1 retroviral transduction into CLL cells; CIITA mentioned peripherally, not a KO.
TNBC patient tumors, correlative APM (TAP1/TAP2/tapasin) DOWNREGULATION -- no genetic KO, no WT/KO contrast.
Immunoproteasome PSMB8/9 OVEREXPRESSION (empty-vector vs OE) -- opposite of KO; OE does not collapse presentation.
Viral immune evasion vs TAP -- PLC PROTEOMICS (tryptic PLC proteins), not eluted ligandome; pharmacologic/viral, not genetic KO.
ERAP1 allotype IN-VITRO enzyme trimming of S1 spike -- not cellular immunopeptidome.
p14/CDKN2A knockdown melanoma -- not APM hard-essential.
TYW2 silencing (tRNA/translation fidelity) -- not APM hard-essential.
beta2m DISSOCIATION from MHC-I (biophysics of free heavy chain) -- not a B2M-KO immunopeptidome contrast.
MOUSE TAPBPR exchange catalyst -- mouse, editor-level.

MISCLASSIFICATION_recheck.question: Were any of the >=32 held 'WT-only' backgrounds actually hiding a hard-essential KO arm?
MISCLASSIFICATION_recheck.result: NO. Re-read PXD022020, PXD000394, PXD071022 (MSI/MSS genotype comparison), PXD072525 (MM TAA discovery), PXD076608 (CML TKI), PXD077352 (covalent neoantigens), PXD028364/PXD037365 (A549 baseline). All are baseline panels, disease-genotype comparisons, or drug/covalent perturbations. None contains a B2M/TAP/TAPBP/NLRC5/PSMB/CIITA genetic KO arm. No misclassification found.

MSV000091285_reattempt.goal: Re-fetch ONX-0914 immunoproteasome-inhibitor HLA-I MS via a NON-FTP route (FTP was blocked).
MSV000091285_reattempt.route_confirmed: MassIVE https DownloadResultFile returns HTTP 200 (e.g. ccms_parameters/params.xml); GNPS datasette (datasetcache.gnps2.org) enumerates the .mzML tree (e.g. Jenifer_20221221_OTE_Aur2hr_J02.mzML = Aurora/ONX-0914 2hr arm). So the FTP block is transport-only; https is fully open.
MSV000091285_reattempt.but_disqualified_for_this_gate: MSV000091285 is a PHARMACOLOGIC UPS/proteasome-inhibition study (its own summary: 'perturbation of the ubiquitin-proteasome system'; ~30% of the MHC-I repertoire is UPS-INDEPENDENT). It is NOT a genetic hard-essential KO and has NO distinct-HLA KO<->WT structure of the type the leave-HLA-out gate needs. Fetchability was the only open question; it does not add a hard-essential KO background.
MSV000091285_reattempt.recommendation: Fetchable if wanted for the proteasome-dependence sub-question, but it is NOT a gate re-power and should not be counted toward the >=3 disjoint-allele requirement.

honest_verdict.one_qualifier: PXD063813 is a genuinely NEW public human B2M-KO immunopeptidome (C1R + K562), which the prior inventory did not hold. It is worth logging. But it does NOT satisfy the gate: no disjoint allele (A*02), and processed files are proteome-only. It is a cheap DIAGNOSTIC lead for the A375 B2M-KO discordance, not a substitute for the CRO's disjoint-allele hard-essential-KO panel.
honest_verdict.bottom_line: The leave-HLA-out gate remains FAIL/UNPROVEN across HLA on public data. No public deposit supplies a hard-essential machinery-KO<->WT immunopeptidome on an allele DISJOINT from the A*02 / HAP1 set. Reaching >=3 disjoint-allele hard-essential backgrounds still requires the CRO experiment.
